vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: dr-context-pipeline
Version: 2.0.0

The dr-context-pipeline bundle is a framework for managing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows within OpenClaw. It provides structured logic for routing tasks (router.yml), retrieving snippets from a local memory directory, and compressing them into a schema-validated 'Context Pack' (context_pack.schema.json). The instructions in SKILL.md and APPLY.md guide the agent to patch its own configuration (AGENTS.md) to adopt this pipeline as a default behavior, which is consistent with the stated goal of standardizing memory management. No indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection were found.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (a deterministic retrieval→compression→lint pipeline) and do not request unrelated credentials, installs, or network endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the assets included: router rules, compressor prompt, retrieval/context schemas, and golden tests. No unexpected binaries, credentials, or config paths are requested. The contents are appropriate for a pipeline that reads a file-based memory layout and produces a Context Pack.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md explicitly instructs the agent to read workspace memory files (memory/always_on.md and memory/topics/*), generate Retrieval Bundles, compress them into Context Packs, and lint them. It also instructs surgical edits to AGENTS.md to make this the default behavior — this is scope-expanding (it writes repo/agent config) but is coherent with the stated 'Apply' action. Recommend human review of any AGENTS.md patches before committing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec, no downloads, and no code files — minimal disk/exec footprint. This is the safest install model for this kind of skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or external config paths are requested. All required inputs are local workspace files documented in the SKILL.md and schemas, which matches the skill's purpose.

The skill will patch AGENTS.md to set the pipeline as default when the user asks — this is an expected privilege but can change agent behavior workspace-wide. Because the skill can be invoked autonomously (platform default), users should review patch changes and test in a branch before enabling as default.

llm.guidance:
This skill appears internally consistent and safe to inspect further, but take these precautions before enabling it as your default pipeline:
- Review the exact AGENTS.md patch the skill proposes (backup or use a branch/PR) before committing; the skill is designed to modify that file. 
- Verify your workspace uses the expected file-based memory layout (memory/always_on.md and memory/topics/*). If not, the pipeline won't work as intended.
- Review the compressor prompt and JSON schemas to confirm they enforce the constraints you want (notably: Context Pack sources are snippet IDs only). 
- Run the included golden tests locally to verify behavior on representative messages. 
- Ensure no sensitive secrets are stored in the workspace memory files, since the pipeline reads them into retrieval bundles (the skill does not send data to external endpoints, but any pipeline that reads workspace content can surface sensitive info to downstream model calls). 
If you want extra assurance, require that the skill produce a diff/PR for AGENTS.md and have a human approve it before applying.
